in_sanskrit.name: सात्विका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The quality of having purity, knowledge, and harmony; the Sattvic Guna

in_marathi.name: Satvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pure and Wise
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'sat' meaning pure and 'vika' meaning wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Satvika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Pure and Wise
in_bengali.long_meaning: Satvika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'sat' meaning pure and 'vika' meaning wisdom.
